lines.en: label halloween6:
scene nightsky
My footsteps lead me down a familiar path.
lines.zh: 我的脚步带着我走上一条熟悉的路。

lines.en: I walk and I walk and I walk-
lines.zh: 我走啊，走啊，走啊——

lines.en: And I look up the entire time.
lines.zh: 而我一直抬头看着天。

lines.en: I see stars.
lines.zh: 我看见了星星。

lines.en: The thing about the stars, especially on nights like this, is that they make all of our theories almost float away in a sense.
lines.zh: 星星这种东西——尤其是在这样的夜晚——会让我们的所有理论在某种意义上几乎飘散而去。

lines.en: It makes me think-
lines.zh: 它让我思考——

lines.en: If there are things this beautiful, anything is possible.
lines.zh: 如果世上存在这么美的事物，那任何事都有可能。

lines.en: It defies logic.
lines.zh: 它违背逻辑。

lines.en: It defies reason.
lines.zh: 它违背理性。

lines.en: Yet, I still believe it while my head is raised.
lines.zh: 然而，只要我抬着头，我就依然相信。

lines.en: These aren’t my thoughts.
lines.zh: 这不是我的想法。

lines.en: scene mayabeach1
scene nightsky
These are someone else’s thoughts.
lines.zh: 这是别人的想法。

lines.en: Someone who likes stars much more than I do.
lines.zh: 一个比我更喜欢星星的人的想法。

lines.en: To be honest, I don’t really care for them at all.
lines.zh: 老实说，我根本就不在乎它们。

lines.en: Or at least, I don’t think I do.
lines.zh: 至少，我觉得我不在乎。

lines.en: Do I?
lines.zh: 我在乎吗？

lines.en: Did I?
lines.zh: 我以前在乎过吗？

lines.en: How did the old Sensei feel about stars?
lines.zh: 以前的那个 Sensei 是怎么看待星星的？

lines.en: And did he also have problems wrapping his head around the borderline nonsensical theories that come with them?
lines.zh: 他是不是也一样，很难理解那些伴随星星而来的、近乎荒谬的理论？

lines.en: How can stars be beautiful?
lines.zh: 星星怎么会美呢？

lines.en: They’re just lights.
lines.zh: 它们只是光而已。

lines.en: Just splotches of brightness in an otherwise empty sky, getting in the way of where the true beauty lies.
lines.zh: 只是一片空荡荡的天空里几点亮斑，挡住了真正的美所在的地方。

lines.en: Beauty is buried behind everything.
lines.zh: 美掩埋在一切的背后。

lines.en: And so we must filter and push our way through waves of shit in order to get to it.
lines.zh: 所以我们必须过滤、必须推开一波又一波的狗屎，才能抵达那里。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: The stars are shit.
lines.zh: 星星就是狗屎。

lines.en: These are my thoughts.
lines.zh: 这才是我的想法。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Maya.
lines.zh: 抱歉啊，Maya。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween1
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: That’s strange.
lines.zh: 真奇怪。

lines.en: Amidst the sea of stars, I {i}do{/i} manage to find something beautiful.
lines.zh: 在这片星海之中，我倒是{i}真的{/i}找到了一样美的东西。

lines.en: : What...are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你……在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I’m on my way to the bar. What are {i}you{/i} doing here?
lines.zh: : 我在去酒吧的路上。{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : And what are you wearing?
lines.zh: : 还有你这身是什么？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween2
: What, am I not allowed to wear something different once it gets colder?
lines.zh: : 什么，天冷了还不许我换件不一样的衣服？

lines.en: : It’s fucking freezing tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚他妈的冷死了。

lines.en: : It’s cold but it’s not {i}that{/i} cold.
lines.zh: : 是冷，但也没冷到{i}那种{/i}程度吧。

lines.en: : I’m not...good with cold weather. Makes my skin all tight and dry and shit.
lines.zh: : 我……不太扛冻。天一冷我的皮肤就又绷又干，烦死了。

lines.en: : Your hair is different too.
lines.zh: : 你头发也变了。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween3
: Jesus, can I not change anything about the way I fucking look without you commenting on it?!
lines.zh: : 靠，我他妈换个造型你就非得点评一番吗？！

lines.en: : Don’t you have somewhere to be?!
lines.zh: : 你不是该去哪儿吗？！

lines.en: : Sorry. I was just thinking that it fits you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是觉得这套挺适合你的。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween4
: Course it fuckin’ fits me. Ponytails are boyish or sporty or whatever and I basically just act like a fucking guy, so...
lines.zh: : 当然他妈适合我。马尾辫本来就偏男孩子气或者运动风什么的，而我基本就是个男的做派，所以……

lines.en: : Sorry for not being out here in a fucking dress.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没穿条他妈的裙子出来。

lines.en: : You should dress like this more often, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你应该多这样穿，Yumi。

lines.en: : Can’t. Gets too fuckin' hot sometimes and I'm not good with heat either.
lines.zh: : 不行。有时候热得要死，而我也不扛热。

lines.en: : So if you’re not good with the cold or the heat, what are you good with?
lines.zh: : 既不扛冷也不扛热，那你擅长什么？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween5
: My fists.
lines.zh: : 我的拳头。

lines.en: : Now beat it.
lines.zh: : 现在给我滚。

lines.en: : Intimidating.
lines.zh: : 真吓人。

lines.en: : Are you going to fight me?
lines.zh: : 你要跟我打一架吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 你要离我远点吗？

lines.en: : Probably not now that I’ve run into you.
lines.zh: : 既然都撞见你了，大概不会。

lines.en: I take a step closer to Yumi and notice her move back on the bench as soon as I do.
lines.zh: 我朝 Yumi 走近一步，然后立刻注意到她往长椅另一头缩了缩。

lines.en: She winces as the feeling of cold wood seeps through her clothing and comes into contact with her back.
lines.zh: 冰冷的木头透过衣服贴上她的后背，她皱了一下眉。

lines.en: I stop moving closer.
lines.zh: 我不再往前靠近了。

lines.en: I can’t blame her for reacting that way given our...No, {i}my{/i} history.
lines.zh: 她会有这种反应我不怪她，考虑到我们的……不，是{i}我的{/i}过去。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween6
: Do whatever you want. Not like you ever fuckin’ listen to me anyway.
lines.zh: : 爱怎样怎样。反正你他妈从来不听我的。

lines.en: : I won’t stay long. I have a party to get to.
lines.zh: : 我不会待太久。我还得去参加派对。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween7
: Party? What kind of person is so lonely that they would invite {i}you{/i} to a party?
lines.zh: : 派对？什么样的人会寂寞到请{i}你{/i}去派对？

lines.en: : Just a few people my age. No one you really know.
lines.zh: : 就是几个和我同龄的人。你都不认识。

lines.en: if streets15 == True:
Well...technically, she’s met Haruka before. But I’m not about to bring up the cafe again when I already know how upset she was about not getting that job.
lines.zh: 嗯……严格来说，她以前见过 Haruka。但我既然知道她没得到那份工作有多难过，就不会再提咖啡馆的事。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween8
: Hah. Yeah right. You hanging out with people your own age? I’m not falling for that.
lines.zh: : 哈。说得跟真的一样。你和同龄人混在一起？我才不上这个当。

lines.en: : How fucking stupid do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你他妈当我有多蠢？

lines.en: : ...No, I’m being serious.
lines.zh: : ……不，我是认真的。

lines.en: : There won’t be a single [teenager] there.
lines.zh: : 那儿一个[teenager]都不会有。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween9
: Holy shit, you actually {i}are{/i} being serious, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 卧槽，你还真他妈{i}是{/i}认真的啊？

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on here?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么情况？

lines.en: : I’m not as bad as you-
lines.zh: : 我才没有你——

lines.en: I cut myself off when I realize that I {i}am{/i} as bad as she makes me out to be.
lines.zh: 当我意识到自己{i}确实{/i}就像她说的那么糟糕时，我把话咽了回去。

lines.en: I need to stop saying things like that around Yumi.
lines.zh: 我得停止在 Yumi 面前说这种话。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween10
: As bad as I {i}what{/i}?...Make you out to be?
lines.zh: : 我才没有你{i}什么{/i}？……说你那么糟糕？

lines.en: : Cause, yeah. You kind of are.
lines.zh: : 因为，没错。你确实就是。

lines.en: : And here I was hoping you wouldn’t have been able to finish that sentence.
lines.zh: : 我还指望你接不下去那句话呢。

lines.en: : Well how else would it have fucking ended?
lines.zh: : 不然那句话还能怎么他妈收尾？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But at least I tried, right?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但至少我试过了，对吧？

lines.en: : Still, though. You and people your own age having a Halloween party? Don’t you think that’s a little out of character?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。你和同龄人办万圣节派对？你不觉得这有点不像你吗？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be at home sniffing your [niece]’s laundry or something?
lines.zh: : 你不是该待在家里闻你[niece]的脏衣服什么的吗？

lines.en: : I’ll have you know I have not done that even once.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你，那种事我一次都没做过。

lines.en: : And what about you? Shouldn’t you be out with Chika trying on Halloween costumes or something?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？你不是该和 Chika 一起出去试万圣节装扮什么的吗？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween11
: I’m not going to wear a fucking Halloween costume. I’m not a kid anymore.
lines.zh: : 我可不会穿什么他妈的万圣节装扮。我又不是小孩了。

lines.en: : And Chika is?
lines.zh: : Chika 是小孩？

lines.en: : No, but Chika is a fucking popular-ass people-person and does {i}all{/i} of that trendy shit.
lines.zh: : 不是，可 Chika 是个他妈的社交达人，专搞{i}那些{/i}时髦玩意儿。

lines.en: : Things like that aren’t meant for people like me.
lines.zh: : 那种东西不适合我这种人。

lines.en: : Besides, don’t even know what the fuck I’d dress up as in the first place.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我他妈根本不知道自己该扮成什么。

lines.en: : Everyone’s probably just going to look slutty as fuck anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正大家大概都会穿得浪得要死。

lines.en: Based on how the two costumes I’ve seen so far have been a full suit of armor and a dolphin, I highly doubt that is going to be the case.
lines.zh: 就我目前看到的两套装扮——一整套盔甲和一只海豚——来看，我非常怀疑事情会是这样。

lines.en: : Are you going to come to the party at least?
lines.zh: : 那你至少会来派对吧？

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你会去吗？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我会。

lines.en: : Then no, I’m good.
lines.zh: : 那我就不去了。

lines.en: : Would you have gone if I told you I wasn’t going?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你我不去，你会去吗？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween12
: Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概也不会。

lines.en: : I don’t see why it matters, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不明白这有什么关系。

lines.en: : Chika would be the only one excited to see me there. Everyone else would probably just feel awkward or scared or some shit.
lines.zh: : 那儿会因为我出现而高兴的只有 Chika。其他人大概只会觉得尴尬、害怕之类的。

lines.en: : Probably. But whose fault is that?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。可那是谁的错？

lines.en: : Oh, definitely mine. I won’t argue with that at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对是我的。这点我一点都不反驳。

lines.en: : But it’s not like just showing up and being all like, “Hey guys! Happy Halloween!” is going to change anyone’s opinion of me.
lines.zh: : 可我也不是一露面、来一句“大家好！万圣节快乐！”就能改变别人对我的看法。

lines.en: : I’ve made my bed and now I’ve gotta fuckin’ lay in it.
lines.zh: : 自作自受，我认了。

lines.en: : Sure, but isn’t tomorrow also your birthday? Missing out on a party {i}and{/i} being alone for your birthday sounds pretty sad, I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可明天不也是你生日吗？错过派对、一个人过生日，说实话听起来挺惨的。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween13
: Wh-
: Why do you know about my birthday?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道我的生日？！

lines.en: scene yumihalloween14
: Did...Did Chika fucking tell you?! I’ll fucking kill her.
lines.zh: : 是……是 Chika 他妈告诉你的？！我他妈要杀了她。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with me knowing your birthday?
lines.zh: : 我知道你的生日有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Afraid I’m going to throw a surprise party for you or something?
lines.zh: : 怕我给你办个惊喜派对什么的？

lines.en: : No! I just don’t want you going home and thinking “Wow, I’m getting closer to Yumi! I know her birthday! Maybe she’ll suck me off soon!” or something.
lines.zh: : 才不是！我只是不想你回家之后想“哇，我和 Yumi 越来越近了！我知道她生日了！说不定她很快就给我口了！”什么的。

lines.en: : How are those things connected at all?
lines.zh: : 这两件事有什么关系？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween15
: Everything is connected, you fucking moron.
lines.zh: : 一切都他妈是连着的，你这个白痴。

lines.en: : If you learn something about someone, intentional or not, you’re going to wind up thinking that you’re getting closer to them.
lines.zh: : 只要你了解了一个人的某件事，不管是有意还是无意，你最后都会觉得你们之间的距离变近了。

lines.en: : Then those thoughts fucking snowball and just roll all over any other thoughts you have until the ball gets so fuckin’ big that you feel like you’re a part of it.
lines.zh: : 然后那些念头就会他妈滚雪球，把你其他所有念头都碾过去，直到那个球大到你觉得自己都成了它的一部分。

lines.en: : But I don’t wanna be a fuckin’ snowball and I don’t want you to think any more about me than you already do.
lines.zh: : 可我不想当什么他妈的雪球，也不想你比现在更频繁地想起我。

lines.en: : Which is probably a lot because you’re a fucking creep.
lines.zh: : 虽然你现在大概已经想得够多了，因为你就是个他妈的变态。

lines.en: : Do you think of {i}me{/i} often, Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi，你经常想起{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween16
: Oh please. The second I start thinking about you for more than five seconds a day, I’m just going to kill myself.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。哪天我要是想你超过五秒钟，我就直接去死。

lines.en: : Afraid of the snowball effect?
lines.zh: : 怕雪球效应？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween3
: So what if I am?!
lines.zh: : 是又怎样？！

lines.en: : Besides, birthdays are fucking stupid anyway. It’s not like it’s an actual holiday or anything.
lines.zh: : 再说，生日本来就他妈蠢。又不是什么真正的节日。

lines.en: : Not everyone wants to be the center of fucking attention. Some people just want to be left alone.
lines.zh: : 不是所有人都想当什么他妈的焦点。有些人只想一个人待着。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming you’re one of those people?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你就是那种人？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween16
: Oh gee, I wonder what gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 哦天哪，真不知道你是怎么看出来的？

lines.en: : It’s not like I literally spend my entire life hiding away from everyone or anything.
lines.zh: : 又不是说我这辈子都在躲着所有人什么的。

lines.en: : You don’t seem to ever hide away from Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你倒是从来不躲 Futaba。

lines.en: : Kinda hard to when she’s the size of-
lines.zh: : 她那么大一只，想躲也躲不——

lines.en: : Yumi.
lines.zh: : Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumihalloween17
Yumi decides against finishing her sentence, and I doubt it's because I stopped her.
lines.zh: Yumi 决定不把那句话说完，而我怀疑原因并不全是我打断了她。

lines.en: I’m not sure if she genuinely feels bad or if she’s just holding back because Futaba isn’t around, but I’m glad to see that she’s willing to at least try to contain herself now.
lines.zh: 我不确定她是真的觉得过意不去，还是只因为 Futaba 不在场才收着，但看到她现在至少愿意试着克制自己，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: : Habit.
lines.zh: : 习惯了。

lines.en: : My bad.
lines.zh: : 我的错。

lines.en: : Don’t apologize to me. Apologize to her.
lines.zh: : 别跟我道歉。跟她道歉。

lines.en: : Nah. I don’t regret any of the shit I’ve said. I just shouldn’t say as much of it.
lines.zh: : 不用。我说过的那些话我一句都不后悔。我只是不该说那么多。

lines.en: : I’d get mad as fuck if someone was always makin’ fun of me.
lines.zh: : 要是有人老拿我开涮，我他妈也会气炸。

lines.en: : But then again, I also wouldn’t just let that shit fly.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我也不会就这么算了。

lines.en: : I’d actually do something about it. And she never fucking does anything.
lines.zh: : 我真会做点什么。可她从来他妈什么都不做。

lines.en: : But there’s no use in talkin’ about someone who ain’t around.
lines.zh: : 不过聊一个不在场的人也没什么意义。

lines.en: : This party thing you’re going to-
lines.zh: : 你要去的那个派对——

lines.en: : Is it close to the dorms?
lines.zh: : 离宿舍近吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Why?
lines.zh: : 不太近。怎么了？

lines.en: : Just wondering.
lines.zh: : 随便问问。

lines.en: She wasn’t planning on asking me to walk her back, was she?
lines.zh: 她该不会是打算让我送她回去吧？

lines.en: : Are you going to stay out here much longer, Yumi? It’s kind of late, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : Yumi，你还要在外面待很久吗？已经挺晚了吧？

lines.en: : Kind of, I guess. I don’t know. Haven’t really thought about it.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我不知道。还真没想过。

lines.en: : Why do you always seem to be out and about in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 你怎么总是大半夜在外面晃？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween5
: I could ask you the same fucking question.
lines.zh: : 这话我他妈也想问你。

lines.en: : I feel like I can’t go anywhere anymore without you bumping into me like it’s part of some fucking script or something.
lines.zh: : 我现在觉得不管去哪儿都能撞见你，就好像这是哪份他妈的剧本里写好的一样。

lines.en: : It’s like the fucking city itself keeps trying to force us together and not realizing that I hate your fucking guts.
lines.zh: : 就好像这座他妈的城市一直在硬把我们凑到一起，却没意识到我恨透了你。

lines.en: : You think the city is somehow responsible for all of these chance encounters?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这座城市在某种程度上要为这些偶遇负责？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween18
: What else would it be?
lines.zh: : 不然还能是什么？

lines.en: : God?
: Fate?
lines.zh: : 命运？

lines.en: : Neither of those things are real.
lines.zh: : 这些东西都不存在。

lines.en: : So saying that Kumon-fucking-mi is responsible is as good a guess as any.
lines.zh: : 所以说到底，怪这座该死的 Kumon-mi 也算是个说得过去的猜测。

lines.en: : Whatever is responsible, though, I want it to stop.
lines.zh: : 不过不管是什么在搞鬼，我希望它停下来。

lines.en: : I miss all of the peace and quiet I used to get before you started getting all...
lines.zh: : 我怀念以前那种清净日子，在你开始变得这么……

lines.en: : However you are now.
lines.zh: : 变成你现在这副样子之前。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: scene yumihalloween19
: If I ask you something really fucking weird, will you promise not to laugh at me?
lines.zh: : 如果我问你一件特别他妈奇怪的事，你能保证不笑我吗？

lines.en: : It really depends on how weird the question is.
lines.zh: : 那得看问题有多奇怪。

lines.en: : Any reason you suddenly want to ask?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然想问了？

lines.en: : Just...something I’ve been wondering.
lines.zh: : 只是……我一直有点在意。

lines.en: : But on second thought, it would probably make me sound insane and I probably already look fucking weird being out here alone in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 不过再想想，问出来大概会让我听起来像个疯子，而我一个大半夜独自在外面晃，看起来大概已经够怪了。

lines.en: : So never mind.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。

lines.en: : Yumi, just ask-
lines.zh: : Yumi，你就问——

lines.en: scene yumihalloween20
: Have you, like...
lines.zh: : 你有没有……

lines.en: : Lost...some of your memories or something?
lines.zh: : 丢……丢掉过一部分记忆什么的？

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……
